task_description: Write a method in Dafny to convert a given sequence of positive integers into a single integer.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method SequenceToInteger(seq: seq<int>) returns (result: int)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The result is a single integer representing the concatenation of all elements in the sequence
- The sequence consists of positive integers
- The concatenation preserves the order of the sequence elements
